game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the oasis keeper must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Syntax Sweep: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: In Bazaar Tents, repeat each round: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the syntax_errors value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about syntax_errors to power up the oasis keeper and open the sandstone arch.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Syntax Sweep
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Syntax Sweep' (Week 9 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Bazaar Tents'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how syntax_errors changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Bazaar Tents.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
